sources.evidence: The current official Nåpu Brewing Co. page identifies Napu Brewing Co. as a Northern Mariana Islands-based brewing company, gives its Garapan, Saipan contact location, and the site footer identifies © 2023 Napu Brewing Co. LLC.
The current official craft-beer menu identifies multiple Nåpu Brewing Co. products as Made in Saipan or Made in CNMI and lists the current Garapan, Saipan location.
